sn4.1:1.6: vatamhi mutto → ṭhito sato (bj, pts) | mutto bodhiṁ samajjhaganti → satto bodhisamajjhagūti (sya-all) | samajjhaganti → sādhu vatamhi satto bodhisamajjhagūti (bj: syā); sādhu vatamhi mutto bodhiṁ samajjhaganti (bj: machasaṁ) | samajjhaga’’nti → sādhu ṭhito sato bodhiṁ samajjheganti (cck: sī. pī.); sādhu vatamhi satto bodhisamajjhagūti (cck: syā. kaṁ.) | bodhisamajjhagūti → sādhu ṭhito sato bodhiṁ samajjhaganti (sya-all: sī. yu.)
sn4.1:3.2: yena → yena na (bj, cck) | māṇavā → mānavā (bj, pts)

sn4.1:5.4: phiyārittaṁva → piyārittaṁ va (bj, sya-all) | phiyārittaṁva dhammani → piyārittam va dhammaniṁ (pts) | piyārittaṁ → phiyā (bj: machasaṁ) | dhammani → vammani (sī.), dhammaniṁ (pī.), jammaniṁ (ka.) etthāyaṁ dhammasaddo sakkate dhanvanaṁ-saddena sadiso maruvācakoti veditabbo, yathā daḷhadhammātipadaṁ (cck note)
